dependency_edges.handoff: Cleaned state profiles and time series feed the panel influence model.
Influence analysis and renewable structure feed the four 3E indices.
Raw index definitions feed entropy/TOPSIS/PROMETHEE ranking.
The current rank and prospect distinction motivate conditional VAR prediction.
Forecast self-sufficiency roles motivate compact allocation constraints.
The allocation formulation is handed to the Genetic Algorithm solver.
Optimized transfers feed A3/A4 targets and policy response formulas.
Appendix code consumes the screened profile data.
MATLAB/R fragments mirror indicator, entropy, VAR, and GA interfaces.

algorithm.convergence_criteria: No screening gate, rank stability test, VAR stability diagnostic, forecast holdout criterion, GA optimality gap, policy feasibility gate, or implementation test is reported.
software: MATLAB/R appendix fragments were read statically; external workbook/CSV dependencies were unavailable and code was not executed.

assumptions: Keep common statistical caliber, electricity-as-renewable proxy, equal-quarter structure, renewable-plus-petroleum identity, zero cooperation cost, constant total consumption, and no-policy forecast boundary explicit.
Separate descriptive profile, panel association, 3E index, composite rank, conditional VAR forecast, compact optimization, GA result, target, action, and implementation evidence.
models.computational_cost: No runtime, memory, evaluation count, convergence log, or scaling analysis is reported.

details: Claims are bounded by four states, 2009 profile, 1979-2009 evolution, conditional 2025/2050 horizons, and source-defined compact constraints.
The allocation and relationship system does not demonstrate equilibrium, feasibility, or stable market clearing.
Historical four-state energy/economic records are referenced, but transformed data and external workbooks are not archived with the PDF.
No uncertainty propagates from data screening, proxy choices, entropy weights, VAR parameters, GA seeds, prices, or policy coefficients into targets.

constraints: Preserve state, year, source category, unit, price base, index direction, forecast condition, importer/exporter role, target metric, and body/memo source role.
Do not promote ranks, fitted coefficients, forecast tables, GA fitness plots, point targets, or policy rhetoric to causal effect, external validation, or realized feasibility.

equation_status.reason: This visual efficiency chain contains no numbered equation.

models.family: appendix code reads external workbooks, maps state data, calculates indicators, runs VAR/GA routines, and is reviewed statically

identifiability_feasibility.analysis: Proxy definitions, four-state scaling, incomplete panel specification, conditional forecasts, uncalibrated trust term, and uncosted cross-state actions prevent causal and implementation identification.

limitations: External inputs are not frozen; code has visible overwrite and extraction risks and was not run.
missing_details: Data lineage, thresholds, units, index directions, fixed effects, entropy/PROMETHEE settings, VAR splits/diagnostics, interval estimates, alpha/beta provenance, GA seeds, capacity/cost/authority/monitoring are absent.
objectives: record implementation evidence without claiming execution

parameter_estimation.method: Panel regression, entropy weighting, TOPSIS/PROMETHEE, ADF/AIC VAR selection, and GA defaults are named, but estimates, splits, diagnostics, provenance, and seed handling are incomplete.

strengths: The source routes data defects to operations, reports a weak geography result before narrowing the question, separates current rank from prospects, labels forecasts no-policy, writes constraints before GA, and discloses explicit weaknesses.
